title: NEMA 17 motor plate with counterbores
prompt: Motor plate for a NEMA 17 stepper: 60 × 60 × 6 mm, centred on the origin on Z = 0, vertical corners rounded R6. A Ø22.5 mm hole in the middle for the motor's centring boss, and four M3 socket-head holes on the motor's 31 mm square pattern, counterbored from the top to the ISO 4762 size. Make the four screw holes counterbored hole features with the M3 preset.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Ø22.5 centring hole on the axis
Four M3 counterbored holes (Ø3.4, ISO 4762 counterbore Ø6.5 × 3.4)
On the 31 mm NEMA 17 square, opening in the top face
13 cylindrical faces: 4 corners, the pilot, 4 holes and 4 counterbores

notes: Construction: screws reads the hole features the prompt asks for (no geometry equivalent in the report), so a correct part built otherwise fails only that test.
